official_source: China Fire and Rescue Yearbook, author-supplied 2020 tables
share_unit: fraction of the corresponding annual total, not percent
temporal_inclusion: 2020 records with valid posting month; deduplicated by date and rounded coordinates.
spatial_inclusion: 2020 records with identifiable province; deduplicated by province, date and rounded coordinates.
sampling_regression: Official counts recovered from shares and annual total; no intercept; exclude provinces with zero proxy events.
spatial_figure_selection: Show top 15 provinces by official share; calculate correlation on all 31 provinces.
public_scope: Derived aggregate shares and proxy counts only. No social-media text, identifiers, coordinates, complete yearbook or source-document images.
